# Demographic, Anthropomorphic, and Clinical Determinants of Serum Triglyceride Levels

## Data Ingestion and Clean

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
```

```{r}
dat_raw <- readRDS("dat_final.rds")

write.csv(dat_raw, "nhanes_triglyceride_raw.csv", row.names = FALSE)
names(dat_raw)

dat_clean <- dat_raw %>%
  select(-any_of(c("id", "hdl", "ldl", "dbp", "sbp"))) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))

write.csv(dat_clean, "nhanes_triglyceride_clean.csv", row.names = FALSE)

dim(dat_clean)
```

## Summary Statistics

```{r}
num_vars <- names(select(dat_clean, where(is.numeric)))

summary_stats <- dat_clean %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(num_vars), list(
    Mean   = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD     = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR    = ~IQR(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min    = ~min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max    = ~max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
  ), .names = "{.col}__{.fn}")) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("Variable", ".value"), names_sep = "__")

kable(
  summary_stats,
  digits = 2,
  caption = paste0("Summary statistics for serum triglycerides and continuous predictors (n = ", nrow(dat_clean), ").")
)

cat_vars <- names(select(dat_clean, where(is.factor)))

for (v in cat_vars) {
  cat("\nDistribution of", v, ":\n")
  print(table(dat_clean[[v]]))
}
```

## Preliminary Model Fitting

```{r}
cat_var <- cat_vars[1]
pred_num_vars <- setdiff(num_vars, "triglyceride")
num_var <- pred_num_vars[1]

prelim_model <- lm(
  triglyceride ~ age + sex + bmi + race_ethnicity + education + 
                income_ratio + protein + carbs + fiber + 
                sex * age,
  data = dat_clean
)

summary(prelim_model)
```

## OLS Estimates, Standard Errors, and 95% Confidence Intervals

```{r}
coef_mat <- summary(prelim_model)$coefficients
ci_mat   <- confint(prelim_model, level = 0.95)

model_table <- data.frame(
  Predictor = rownames(coef_mat),
  Estimate  = round(coef_mat[, "Estimate"], 2),
  SE        = round(coef_mat[, "Std. Error"], 2),
  CI_Lower  = round(ci_mat[, 1], 2),
  CI_Upper  = round(ci_mat[, 2], 2),
  t_stat    = round(coef_mat[, "t value"], 2),
  p_value   = ifelse(coef_mat[, "Pr(>|t|)"] < 0.001, "< 0.001", 
                     round(coef_mat[, "Pr(>|t|)"], 3)),
  row.names = NULL
)

kable(
  model_table,
  caption = paste0("OLS estimates, standard errors, and 95% CIs for preliminary model (n = ", nrow(dat_clean), ").")
)
```

## Residual Analysis and Assumption Check

```{r}
fit <- fitted(prelim_model)
res <- resid(prelim_model)

par(mfrow = c(1, 4), mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 2.5, 1.5))

plot(fit, dat_clean$triglyceride, pch = 16, cex = 0.5, col = "steelblue",
     xlab = "Fitted Values", ylab = "Observed Triglycerides",
     main = "Y vs. Fitted")
abline(a = 0, b = 1, col = "red", lty = 2)

plot(prelim_model, which = c(1, 2, 5), col = "steelblue", pch = 16, cex = 0.5)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
